target_customer: Young consumers who want a small private space for close friends, capped at 20 friends
problem: Mainstream social networks became public performance feeds and friend groups moved to messaging apps, leaving no good shared space for close friends.
business_model: Consumer app, ad free at launch; no revenue model found
product_category: Consumer social network for close friends

founders.name: Jeremy Berman
education: Dropped out of a computer science master's program to work on Basement

founders.name: Fernando Rojo
founders.background_notes: Now Head of Mobile at Vercel per the YC page; that is after Basement.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile feed and friend graph with a 20 friend cap is standard app engineering for two people.

defensibility.rationale: Network effects only exist within each friend group, and Instagram, Snapchat and iMessage groups could host the same behavior; copyable in weeks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Instagram launched Close Friends for Stories in November 2018 and Threads in 2019, covering the wedge; Basement shut down without public explanation.

market_need_then: TechCrunch coverage in March 2019 described friend groups moving conversations to private messaging; demand evidence is anecdotal from the founders.

branding.domain_note: basement.social, a .social domain; basement.studio and other Basement companies share the name.

identity.voice_and_tone: Intimate, meme friendly, ad free and influencer free

branding.brand_signature: The hangout in the basement metaphor and the 20 friend cap
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by TechCrunch, Reclaim The Net and Trend Hunter in 2019 for its micro network concept; feed leaned on friends tagging memes.

brand_strength.rationale: Evocative name and some 2019 press, but search results are dominated by other Basement companies and no lasting community found.

outcome_analysis: Basement launched through YC in Winter 2019 as a close friends social network capped at 20 friends and drew press from TechCrunch. The YC directory lists it as Inactive, but no shutdown notice, post-mortem or acquisition was found, so the cause is not public. Strong incumbents already offered similar features, and no funding beyond the YC deal was found.
notes: CB Insights lists about 150K seed from YC on 2019-03-18, single aggregator, so not recorded as a round. Site basement.social did not resolve in the fetch tool, treated as dead or blocked. Competitor search returned Instagram Close Friends (2018) and Cocoon (2019 launch) but with sources I could not date to the batch precisely, so the list is empty. Founded year is an estimate from the launch timeline. Exit type shutdown follows directory status Inactive, not a confirmed closure notice. Completeness pass: seed of 150K on 2019-03-18 recorded from CB Insights alone; TechCrunch launch coverage of the same date was not shown to state the amount. A different Basement (Vortx, Brazil) round was excluded.
